name: cambium-infinite-game
description: Tenant-scoped Cambium infinite-game reader and Gate action adapter. Returns digest-verified provenance, prepares deterministic Dot task state, and runs exact actions through founder review before separate receipt-backed execution.

interface.longDescription: Private, tenant-scoped surface that exposes Cambium's infinite-game provenance (Vision, Mission, ISA, GSD, D1, Runs, Receipts, Cortex learning) to an approved workspace audience. Reads return bounded digest-verified envelopes. Action identity is derived from verified OAuth context; compilation is non-writing, a durable review request appears in the founder Gate, approval is non-executing, and execution accepts only that exact approved tuple with replay-safe authoritative readback. Cortex never receives direct D1 writer authority, and Hermes remains the delivery authority.
defaultPrompt: Explain why an ISA criterion is currently blocked.
Trace a D1 task backward to Mission and Vision.
Request founder review for an exact compiled action.
